name: @berger-engineering/nx-remote-cache-custom
description: Self-hosted Nx remote cache server (Nx custom remote cache OpenAPI spec) with MinIO/S3 and Azure Blob Storage backends, read-only/read-write tokens and write-once uploads (CREEP mitigation).
author: Michael Berger <michael.berger@berger-engineering.io>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && node scripts/fix-declarations.mjs && chmod +x dist/main.js
